title: Czarnecki Sławomir
name: Czarnecki Sławomir
description: composer and teacher; b. 23rd July 1949 in Jelenia Góra. He studied composition with Piotr Perkowski and Romuald Twardowski at the State Higher School of Music in Warsaw (master’s degree in 1974) and in 1980-81 with Olivier Messiaen in Paris (thanks to a French government scholarship). He has received numerous awards and honourable mentions in composition competitions, including the 1st prize in a competition for educational work in Wrocław for Piano Concerto for Young People No.1 Op. 6 (1973), the 2nd prize in the Composition Competition of the 9th Festival of Polish Piano Art in Słupsk for Concertino per pianoforte e orchestra Op. 9 (1975), the 1st prize in the Young Composers’ Competition of the Polish Composers’ Union for Gradito per orchestra Op. 12 (1976), an honourable mention in the 19th Concorso Internazionale di Composizione “Premio Cittá di Trieste” for Concerto pesante per tuba e orchestra Op. 14 (1980), Darmstadt City Award in the Chopin-Gesellschaft Competition for Symphonia concertante per pianoforte e orchestra op. 16 (1980), twice the 1st price in the Competition of the Warsaw Section of the Polish Composers’ Union – for Intrada, Elegy and Postlude Op. 19 for organ(1982) and for Orpheus Songs Op. 24 for counter-tenor, flute, oboe and harp (1985), the Bucchi Award in Rome for Five Pieces for Piano for Children – Forest Roaming Op. 25 (1986), the 3rd prize in the Karol Szymanowski Competition for Composers for Music from Zawrat Op. 31 for double-bass and piano (1992), the Gdańsk City Award in the 1000th Anniversary Competition of the City of Gdańsk for Hymnus Gedanensis Op. 36 – symphonic poem for mixed choir and great symphony orchestra (1997). His works are in the repertoire of such renowned performers as violinists Krzysztof and Jakub Jakowicz, cellist Tomasz Strahl, the Amadeus Orchestra, the Concerto Avenna Orchestra, the National Philharmonic Chamber Orchestra in Warsaw and the Schola Cantorum Gedanensis Polish Chamber Choir. A number of the composer's works have been published by PWM Edition and TONOS Publishing House from Darmstadt. Apart from composing, he is also a teacher. Since 1974 he has taught at the Józef Elsner State Secondary Music School in Warsaw. In the years 1989-1992 he was its deputy director. He started an "Introduction to Composition" class and he has raised a number of young composers, winners of prestigious composition competitions. Czarnecki was also one of the initiators of the Students' Music Forum – a festival organized since 1996, presenting works by students and graduates of the Józef Elsner Music School. In 2001 he became a certified teacher. In 2006 he received a habilitation degree in composition and music theory from the Grażyna and Kiejstut Bacewicz Academy of Music in Łódź. Since 2006 he has been working at the Department of Music Education of the Kazimierz Wielki University in Bydgoszcz, currently as a professor. Sławomir Czarnecki is a member of the ZAiKS Authors' Association, the Polish Composers' Union and the Karol Szymanowski Music Society, where he served as vice-president and currently is a member of the Management Board. Since 2011 he has been the president of the Warsaw Branch of the Polish Composers' Union. Thanks to his efforts, the Polish Composers' Union established a foundation called the Warsaw Music Encounters (2014). He was honored with many decorations, including the Silver Cross of Merit (1996), the Medal of the Commission of National Education (2004), the Decoration of Honor "Meritorious for Polish Culture" (2006), the Silver Medal for Merit to Culture – Gloria Artis (2009), and the Golden Cross of Merit (2019). updated: 2020 (Agnieszka Cieślak) CONTACT Phone: +48 604 220 784 e-mail: This email address is being protected from spambots.
